scenario: [LTSL.2.3]: a section keyword must not appear more than once per test, and a repeated one is REFUSED with DS_VALIDATE_TEST_DUPLICATE_SECTION -- not merged in source order, and not overridden by the last. Two `produces` sections; the test is otherwise well-formed. Path: `dsc.dstest.ltsl_2_3_once`, which refuses the second occurrence at its own position.
rules_ds:
schema Reading scope logical:
    zone: String key
    celsius: Float mutable

rule cold:
    Reading r where r.celsius < 5.0
->
    log info "cold"

test "twice":
    inputs:
        at 0_s:
            Reading zone: "a" celsius: 1.0
    produces:
        activated cold
    produces:
        activated cold
